# Table fixture

A claim can hide in a markdown table cell just as easily as in prose — the
README extras table is exactly the kind of place this guard has to reach.

| ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tools` | `pyroma` (the **Python** path of `packaging_ok`)            |
| `wheel` | the CLI invokes `flimflam` on every packaging artifact      |
